shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
upright rectangular slab/panel dominating the frame
horizontal registers or banded divisions of the carved field
repeated small motifs aligned in rows
justification: Both show a tall, pale, weathered stone panel carved in shallow relief and organised into stacked horizontal registers, photographed in situ amid rough rock, which gives a broadly comparable overall format. The decisive difference is content and handling: A carries bold, plastic, clearly legible animal and anthropomorphic figures with strong modelling, while B's surface bears only faint, fine, evenly ruled rows of small incised signs, largely effaced, with no comparable figural imagery.
